QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] City Below the Waves
QuestInfo.0: Find Eremos and see where the next stage of your training will take place.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos explains that Aqua Road is an extreme environment just like Orbis and, therefore, perfect for your training needs. You'll need to hunt 1,500 monsters in Aqua Road.
QuestInfo.2: Your rigorous training in Aqua Road has impressed Eremos.
